newsitem.title: UK: DTB consultant sees threat from information firms.
newsitem.headline: DTB consultant sees threat from information firms.

text.p: Electronic trading faces a possible threat from information providers as technological changes gain pace, a Deutsche Terminboerse (DTB) consultant said on Thursday.

"We have to accept that Bloomberg and Reuters could use their screens to take over from exchanges. We shouldn't rest on our laurels," said Brendan Bradley, a DTB derivatives consultant, at a derivatives industry conference in London.
He said screen trading had a strong advantage from a regulatory point of view in that it allowed an "immediate audit trail" to assist in investigations.
Information providers include companies like Reuters Holdings Plc, Bloomberg LP and Dow Jones & Co. Inc, which all have proprietary world-wide distribution systems for electronic information.
